capability: Evaluate the Sauter ion-ion weak-coupling Coulomb logarithm from temperature, density and charge state.
operation: evaluate the Sauter ion-ion Coulomb logarithm
discovery.model: Sauter/NRL Coulomb-log relation ln Lambda = 30 - 0.5 ln(n_i) + 1.5 ln(1000 T_i) - 3 ln(Z_i) with explicit numeric boundary checks.
discovery.geometry: Homogeneous plasma point with all three input arrays broadcast; no spatial geometry is inferred.
discovery.boundary: T_i in keV, n_i in m^-3 and Z_i must be finite and strictly positive.

identity.direction: ion temperature, density and charge -> dimensionless logarithm
identity.definition: Sauter 1999 ion-ion weak-coupling fit 30-0.5*ln(n_i)+1.5*ln(1000*T_i)-3*ln(Z_i), not NRL 2013 Eq. c. Evaluation uses ln(1000)+ln(T), avoiding intermediate overflow/underflow.
identity.model: Sauter ion-ion Coulomb-log relation with explicit SciRel numeric boundary checks
identity.boundary: strictly positive finite T_i in keV, n_i in m^-3, Z_i dimensionless
assumptions: The caller decides whether the weak-coupling estimate is physically adequate.
Charge is a positive scalar or broadcast field, not a species mixture.

inputs.name: T_i
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and strictly positive; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

inputs.name: n_i
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and strictly positive; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

inputs.name: Z_i
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and strictly positive; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Finite signed mathematical formula value; physical suitability for a collision model is caller-owned.

preconditions: strictly positive finite T_i in keV, n_i in m^-3, Z_i dimensionless
supported: Finite NumPy evaluation of the declared relation and broadcast shape.
excluded: Whole-transport evolution, experimental calibration, and implicit coordinate reconstruction.
Interpreting zero or negative computed logarithms as valid weakly coupled collision physics; physical calibration or a regime-switching model.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for boolean/string/complex/masked or empty input, non-finite values, malformed or incompatible shape, and the nonpositive or singular domains named by the callable contract.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises FloatingPointError if accepted finite inputs produce an unrepresentable output; no fallback is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this is a direct algebraic mapping.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No output is returned after an exception.

example.description: Run the relation on a finite declared-domain case.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.physics import calculate_log_lambda_ii
r=calculate_log_lambda_ii(3., 2e19, 2.)
assert np.isfinite(r)

scope: Independent 60-digit Decimal logarithms verify the declared Sauter fit over temperature/density/charge scales, including smallest subnormal and largest float64; transformation/scaling identities.
Declared failure cases for empty, boolean/string/complex/masked, nonfinite and incompatible inputs.
Agreement with the canonical SciRel callers and dependencies of this relation.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Maintained tests establish the declared Sauter 1999 ion-ion fit, shapes and numerical boundaries only. They do not establish global physical calibration or NRL 2013 Eq. c; an independent NRL transcription differs by +0.4388 in ln Lambda.
known_limitations: No external calibration or collision-frequency composition is claimed.
Only the declared Sauter 1999 ion-ion fit algebra and numerical boundaries are covered; this is not a general Coulomb-log model.

This relation is not NRL 2013 Eq. c. An independent transcription of NRL 2013 Eq. c differs by a constant +0.4388 in ln Lambda on probes; the Sauter formula is retained and must not be cited as NRL 2013 Eq. c.
